items.t: Putnam County boy in quarterfinals of Stan Lee’s Super Kid contest
items.x: Sheriff’s deputies are asking people to show their support for nine-year-old Landon.

items.t: China takes Mbappé's apology 'seriously' after backlash over his ‘Chinese dictator’ comments
items.x: China has acknowledged soccer star Kylian Mbappé's apology for comments seen as disrespectful to Mao Zedong, the founding leader of Communist China.

items.t: Male supplements recalled for not declaring erectile dysfunction drugs and unapproved SSRI in products
items.x: A male supplement has been recalled after it was found to contain three undeclared drugs that make up two prescription erectile dysfunction medications.

items.t: South Korea fines Google and Apple over unfair app market practices
items.x: South Korea on Wednesday fined Google and Apple a combined $47.6 million, saying they abused their dominance in app store markets by forcing local developers onto their own payment systems and by unfairly delaying app reviews.

items.t: Flávio Bolsonaro flees Brazil through Argentina, en route to Ecuador, migration authority says
items.x: Flávio Bolsonaro, the defeated Brazilian presidential candidate, has fled to Argentina and is heading to Ecuador with his family, according to Argentina's migration authority.

items.t: A ceasefire in a devastated Ukrainian city holds for its first 30 hours, officials say
items.x: Officials say that a six-day ceasefire in the Russian-occupied city of Oleshky in southern Ukraine has held for its first day and night.

items.t: Lafayette High School student named presidential scholar
items.x: The Lafayette High School student is one of four students in Florida and one of 161 across the country to receive the honor.

items.t: Gainesville woman convicted in Medicare fraud scheme
items.x: Department of Justice officials say Sophie Dufort, 57, was convicted in a fraud scheme.

items.t: Belleview man faces charges after being accused of stealing $85,000 worth of jewelry
items.x: Deputies say Keith Verner, 54, pawned off the jewelry over the course of several months, selling pieces at stores dating back to August.

items.t: County commissioners approve contract for new Alachua County Animal Resources director
items.x: County commissioners without comment approved a contract for Meredith McLean, currently director of Collier County Animal Services.

items.t: Branford volleyball team sweeps Aucilla Christian; Williston wins in four
items.x: The Branford volleyball team returns to state; Williston survives four sets to win regionals.

items.t: Trinity Catholic sweeps First Academy to win Class 2A regional title
items.x: The Trinity Catholic volleyball team looks to avenge their 2024 state tourney loss.

items.t: Son indicted in mother’s death; medical staff say she had feces, insects in hair
items.x: A man has been indicted on charges related to the death of his mother in Alabama.

items.t: Florida closes home exhibition slate with 85-68 win over Stetson
items.x: The Gators may have found their three-point shooting duo with Denzel Aberdeen/Urban Klavzar going 10 of 17.

items.t: Israelis await final election results as Netanyahu remains far from defeated
items.x: Israelis are closely awaiting final election results after their voting delivered a rebuke to Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's far-right government.

items.t: Serbian police say assailant killed after attacking officer outside the Israeli Embassy in Belgrade
items.x: An assailant with knives attacked a police officer guarding the Israeli Embassy in Belgrade and was killed just after midnight on Wednesday.

items.t: Junior Caminero injures foot during Rays' rally but says he'll play in World Series Game 5
items.x: All-Star slugger Junior Caminero injured his left foot during the Tampa Bay Rays’ late rally in Game 4 of the World Series but said he’ll play Wednesday in Game 5.

items.t: Canned fruit sold at Walmart recalled in several states
items.x: The Food and Drug Administration said the recall applies to 15-ounce containers of Great Value Fruit Cocktail in Fruit Juice from Concentrate.

items.t: UK Treasury chief faces headwinds as he delivers first budget under new prime minister, Andy Burnham
items.x: British Treasury chief John Healey faces a fine balancing act when he delivers his first budget statement, with the economic backdrop made more difficult as a result of the turmoil caused by the Iran war.

items.t: Rays stun Brewers with 2-run rally in 12th inning and force World Series Game 5 with 4-3 win
items.x: Jonny DeLuca and pinch-hitter Ben Williamson singled home runs in a stunning 12th-inning rally, and the Tampa Bay Rays staved off World Series elimination with a 4-3 win over the Milwaukee Brewers that forced Game 5.
